description: Calls a view/pure function on any Monad contract. Accepts ABI as either a parsed array or a Solidity-signature string (one per line). Args are JSON; uint/int values may be passed as decimal strings to preserve precision.

anyOf.description: Human-readable Solidity signature(s), one per line.

abi.description: Either a JSON ABI array (from artifacts) or a human-readable signature like 'function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)'.

function.description: Function name to call (must be view/pure).

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: read_contract
title: Read any contract's view function
